name: Frontier AI diffuses into white-collar workflows
description: General reasoning systems become standard in finance, law, media, and software operations.

name: Compute and grid bottlenecks
description: Data center buildout and power constraints sharpen competition over compute and energy.

name: Social buffering pilots expand
description: Some blocs begin structure-credit rails, wage buffering, and public adaptation infrastructure.

name: Physical AI enters logistics and warehousing
description: Robotics adoption reaches ports, warehouses, delivery, and routine manufacturing.

name: Housing and debt squeeze
description: Cost-of-living stress and debt servicing intensify political anger in several regions.

name: Climate adaptation gap widens
description: Heat, water, and crop volatility accumulate unevenly across the system.

name: Strategic blocs harden
description: Semiconductor, robotics, and industrial policy blocs deepen sanctions and trade friction.

name: Resilience capital rotation
description: Capital winners can increasingly rotate profits into redundancy, care, and distribution systems.

name: Food-water shocks and migration pressure
description: Repeated regional disruptions produce migration, welfare strain, and internal political backlash.

name: Institutional settlement attempt
description: Late-stage settlements try to stabilize distribution, public legitimacy, and cross-border resilience.
